title: Upper Savannah published assessments and native watershed membership

summary.coordinateMeaning: Original native x/y strings and CRS from the source owner's exact identity crosswalk.
summary.hucMeaning: Published assessment HUC identifiers compared with station publisher HUC identifiers at their reported level.
summary.geographicMembership: The existing station-geography operator computes membership from original points and the retained 217-HUC polygon source.

native_geography.title: Completed original station and watershed polygon context

method.membership: Original Esri ring assembly from retained capture method; exact covers after native CRS transform to EPSG:5070
method.publisher_assignments: Assessment publisher, station publisher and geometric HUC assignments remain separate
method.coordinate_accuracy: PROJ operation accuracy is retained as transformation context; it is not a station-position or boundary-accuracy measurement. Points are never snapped.
method.boundaries: All matching polygons and operation-accuracy-near boundaries are retained; no single-HUC winner is imposed.

EPSG:3857.description: Inverse of Popular Visualisation Pseudo-Mercator + Inverse of NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) + Conus Albers

EPSG:26917.description: Inverse of UTM zone 17N + Conus Albers
EPSG:26917.definition: proj=pipeline step inv proj=utm zone=17 ellps=GRS80 step proj=aea lat_0=23 lon_0=-96 lat_1=29.5 lat_2=45.5 x_0=0 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80

EPSG:4326.description: Inverse of NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) + Conus Albers (with axis order normalized for visualization)
EPSG:4326.definition: proj=pipeline step proj=unitconvert xy_in=deg xy_out=rad step proj=aea lat_0=23 lon_0=-96 lat_1=29.5 lat_2=45.5 x_0=0 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80

source.selection: Union of original upstream_huc12s plus focal HUCs; exact root-transmitted arrays

methodology: Assessment membership uses each retained assessment edition's published HUC12.
Station membership uses only the native station publisher's reported HUC level; HUC8-only rows remain unresolved at HUC12.
The exact source-bound assessment ID and native station identity crosswalk join every record. Original coordinates and CRS remain untransformed.
NRCS FY26 priority context follows the original state-HUC rows for each reported HUC12; it does not score or reassign an assessment record.
Mapped membership is read from the completed native assessment context and verified against every original station coordinate and assessment identity; publisher assignments remain unchanged.
Counts distinguish original assessment records, distinct sites and HUCs. The same site can occur in multiple assessment editions.
A difference between publisher labels is a source distinction; choosing a source label does not change the original assessment.
NRCS priority, published assessment status, mapped point membership, classified reaches and modelled export retain their separate meanings.
